Ballerina is a modern elegant serif typeface that blends timeless sophistication with graceful italic movement. Designed with high-contrast strokes, elongated proportions, and refined serif details, it creates a luxurious visual style that feels expressive, feminine, and effortlessly chic.

Perfect for fashion branding, beauty products, wedding invitations, luxury packaging, magazine editorials, logos, and premium social media designs, Ballerina delivers a distinctive display presence while maintaining excellent readability.
